articles.title: 'It's Been a Sh*tshow' — Esports Casters Call for Change After Embark Studios Replaces Talent for The Finals' Grand Major Qualifier Highlight Reel With Game's AI Commentators
articles.summary: The Grand Major, an official tournament for Embark Studios' first-person shooter The Finals, is at the center of a heated debate after the developer replaced its real-life esports casters with AI commentators in a now-deleted highlight reel.
body: Embark Studios is facing backlash after a now-deleted video was uploaded to The Finals' official social media accounts recapping highlights from The Grand Major’s APAC Closed Qualifiers. The audio commentary that played over the video is at the center of this blowback, as the casters who originally commentated these matches were replaced by the game's fictional AI commentators, Scotty and June. While this video has since been removed from public viewing, remarks from casters in the community paint a grim picture of what they saw.

“After four cycles, open/closed [qualifiers], the time, effort, passion, and emotion myself, @TheeHyperactive, and @bluepanda_casts put in, we get replaced by two AI casters who even quote us. I get they are a part of the game, but yikes. Thanks @reachthefinals,” commentator Proto / Kai wrote in a viral post on Twitter/X.

articles.summary: Target has officially revealed its Black Friday plans for 2026. According to the retailer's most recent press release, the official Black Friday sale will kick off this Sunday, November 22.
body: In addition to the start date and the giveaway, Target has also revealed its full Black Friday ad for next week. This preview doesn't include everything that will be discounted, but it does give you an idea of what to expect from the sale and when to expect it.

Target has already launched several early Black Friday sales in November, but these upcoming discounts look to be the good stuff. The start of the sale coincides with Nintendo's Black Friday start date, so you can expect the hottest item to be the Switch 2 bundle again this year.

Target's Black Friday ad for 2026 leads with the Nintendo Switch 2 bundle discount, which is likely going to be the only console deal of the year. articles.title: BioWare Is Dead, But Mass Effect’s Spiritual Successor Exodus Just Gave Us A Glimpse of A Spicy Romance
articles.summary: For the first time since its announcement during December 2023's The Game Awards, players are getting a look at the female player-character from its upcoming sci-fi RPG Exodus --which was full of Mass Effect DNA back when we previewed it in September.
body: The default female version of main character Jun Aslan was revealed today via a seven-minute featurette showing off both female-Jun's face and a bit more of the game itself. The trailer also provided a glimpse of a brief romance scene between female-Jun and Suliman, who is one of the game's romanceable NPCs.

When GameSpot previewed the game, only male-Jun was playable, and we didn't get a chance to romance Suliman, but we did manage to earn his approval, suggesting he may be into both masculine and feminine Jun. We also didn't see the character creator, but there certainly appears to be one, as we see Jun sporting a different look during the romantic encounter with Suliman, with voice actress Carina Corti ( Mafia: The Old Country, Little Death ) providing Jun's voice throughout both scenes.

Jun's male character model recently got a complete makeover after players complained his original look wasn't pleasing to the eye, but up until today, it wasn't clear who was voicing him. Today, Archetype shared that Stephen Oyoung ( Marvel's Spider-Man, Marvel's Spider-Man 2 ) will be voicing the character.

articles.title: GTA 6 Fans Baffled After Jason's Actor Gets Left Out of Game Awards Nominations
articles.summary: GTA 6 fans are a bit surprised that the actor playing Jason wasn't nominated at The Game Awards. Earlier today, The Game Awards gave us our first indicator of how GTA 6 will be received. It's up for eight awards, including Game of the Year.
body: However, the actor who plays the game's other protagonist was not nominated. Fans were taken aback, since the two are clearly a package deal in the game, and one has to imagine they elevate each other. However, the jury must not have felt strongly enough about Jason to give his actor the nomination. There's no rule against nominating multiple actors for a single project, either. Last year, three performers from Expedition 33 were all nominated in the same category, after all.

Jason has been seen as a much more subtle and reserved character compared to Lucia. He's a bit quieter, isn't too flashy with his actions, and maybe lacks the fire in his character compared to someone like Lucia. One fan on Reddit noted that Jason didn't make a strong impression on them in any of the trailers: "Honestly, I'm not a fan of his VO," they said. "Jason doesn't sound good, at least in the footage we saw; he lacks diction. Most of the time, I can't understand what he's saying without subs."

articles.title: Civilization Dev Lays Off 1/3 Of Staff, New XCOM Game Facing “Development Struggles” – Report
articles.summary: The video game industry's woes continue as Take-Two's 2K division has confirmed that one third of the staff at Civilization and XCOM developer Firaxis Games is being laid off. Bloomberg confirmed the cuts, which will impact around 60 people.
body: A spokesperson for Firaxis confirmed the restructuring to Bloomberg, saying the cuts are part of an effort to "focus on design, technology, and player experience."
"These decisions are never easy, but they’re essential to build the next chapter of Firaxis," the spokesperson said.

According to Bloomberg's sources, Firaxis is working on a new XCOM game, but it has faced "development struggles" and missed a major milestone this past summer. The game is still going ahead, though the sources said it "may face a shakeup" due to the layoffs.

The latest game from Firaxis, Sid Meier's Civilization VII, was released in February 2025 and had numerous technical issues upon release, though the experience has been improved since then with updates. The entire Civilization series has sold more than 80 million units.

articles.title: GTA 6's Release Will Stress The Internet Just As Everything's Falling Apart
articles.summary: In early November, some internet service providers warned their customers that pre-downloads of Grand Theft Auto 6 were causing network slowdown issues for everyone on the service. That problem became visible before millions of gamers tried to log into the same game simultaneously.
body: If you've ever been around for the release of a big new game, you know that day-one network issues are fairly common. Some hiccups are worse than others, of course, but most people are probably already bracing for some potential hitches when we're talking about the biggest game launch of all time. What makes GTA 6 different from other game releases is its scale and timing.

The highly anticipated sequel first began causing issues for some ISPs when Rockstar opened preloads for the 212 GB game on Nov. 10. At the time, some providers claimed that the game was directly responsible for never-before-seen traffic peaks so high that they congested the proverbial internet tubes for everyone else.

Rockstar undoubtedly foresaw that the problem could occur or worsen by launch day. The studio dropped a couple of patches in a staggered rollout prior to launch. The release cadence made it less likely that GTA 6 fans could overload Rockstar's, PlayStation's, and Xbox's servers at the same time. Service providers have also been gearing up for Nov. 19, with at least one ISP advertising that it would offer increased download speeds specifically for GTA 6.

That problem became visible before millions of gamers tried to log into the same game simultaneously.

articles.title: 007 First Light Might Be The End Of The Line For James Bond’s Favorite Watch
articles.summary: After months of searching and numerous potential frontrunners, Robert Pattinson has been cast as the next James Bond. It's lead to some questions about whether he's too famous or too old for the role, whether or not he looks like Bond, and just how different his portrayal might be to those that…
body: James Bond has long had recognizable brand associations, but one that has endured has been the partnership with luxury watch maker Omega. Bond was first seen wearing an Omega in 1995's GoldenEye, and was mostly recently seen sporting the latest iteration of the Seamaster Diver 300m in this year's 007 First Light. Although not a new film in the series, First Light still featured its own unique take on the Seamaster, the first ever created for a videogame, with Omega adding it to its bursting 007 collection that it makes available for purchase.

So given that it's been three decades, why could First Light be the last iteration of James Bond wearing an Omega? Simply put, Robert Pattinson doesn't wear one, and has very recently become a brand ambassador for one of Omega's Swiss competitors, Jaeger-LeCoultre. There's no confirmation that Pattinson's obligations will directly influence a brand deal between Omega and new Bond owners Amazon, but the omission of any watch at all in the announcement trailer sure has cause some speculation.

We could have had Pokémon Pokopia, Big Walk, and Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave. Instead, we got yet more games made in GTA's image.

articles.title: Resident Evil Requiem’s Game Awards Nominee Is Ready for Resident Evil 10
articles.summary: Angela Sant'Albano had never performed in a video game before Resident Evil Requiem. She'd never done motion capture, either. But after spending months physically throwing herself into the horror of Grace Ashcroft's story, she came away convinced that the medium was a perfect fit.
body: “I honestly couldn't have been luckier to be in Resident Evil,” Sant'Albano told Polygon a few weeks before her 2026 Game Awards nomination. “I still pinch myself.”
What surprised her most was how little she felt she had to change as a performer. Motion capture, she says, gave her the intimacy of television with the physical freedom of theater.

“Imagine you're doing theater in the round. So you have the audience 360 degrees around you, but then you have the intimacy of television and screen because you have a camera right here with you,” she says. “You can have an incredibly internal dialogue while also having the freedom of the body.”

And Requiem demanded plenty of body. The game's cutscenes were captured with the actors performing everything themselves, often in a darkened studio at London's Imaginarium Studios. Sant'Albano would run, fight, crawl, struggle, and generally work herself into a state of believable panic before scenes that required Grace to be gasping for breath.

articles.title: Newzoo analyst expects Grand Theft Auto to turn around a rough year for console gaming: 'without GTA 6 the console market would likely be down year-over-year in 2026'
articles.summary: Consoles cost more than ever, and even if you can afford to buy one you don't have as much left over to buy games for it as you used to. That's made 2026 an underwhelming year for console gaming sales, but according to the latest forecast from videogame market analysts Newzoo, the imminent launch…
body: "As we explored in the Global Games Market Report 2026," said Newzoo's director of market intelligence, Emmanuel Rosier, "without GTA VI the console market would likely be down year-over-year in 2026. Instead, the game's launch is expected to generate billions of dollars in revenue and give console spending a significant boost."

Rosier is the analyst who, back in August, was skeptical about the idea of BioWare surviving long enough to make another Mass Effect game. I wish he'd been wrong about that, but it turned out he was right on the money with that prediction.

"Western console has been losing ground," he went on to say. "Its share of global games revenue fell from 21.5% in 2015 to 17.1% in 2025, and its revenue has been broadly flat since 2021. Console adoption shows the same pattern. In Western markets, the console player base has been flat since 2022. Most people who want to play on console already do."

articles.title: The Game Awards 2026 nominees announced, and GTA 6 leads with eight nods before it's even out
articles.summary: The Game Awards 2026 nominees have been revealed, and Grand Theft Auto 6 leads the pack with eight nominations, two days before it even launches.
body: Rockstar's crime epic is up for Game of the Year, Best Game Direction, Best Narrative, Best Art Direction, Best Score and Music, Best Audio Design, and Best Action/Adventure Game. Its eighth nomination is Manni L. Perez's Best Performance nod for her role as Lucia, which is how we found out who plays her in the first place.

For Game of the Year, GTA 6 is up against 007 First Light, Control Resonant, Phantom Blade Zero, Resident Evil Requiem, and The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. Nintendo is the most-nominated publisher, with 12 nominations across its games, followed by Capcom with 11, and Annapurna Interactive and PlayStation with nine each.

The nominees were picked by a jury of more than 160 media and creator outlets, who may get advance or pre-release access to games - which explains how GTA 6 made the cut before launch. The winners will be revealed on Thursday, 10th December, at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles. Fans can vote on The Game Awards' website until 6pm PT on 9th December.

articles.title: Miami Heat shows off its 'Vice City hardwood' ahead of the big Grand Theft Auto 6 basketball game
articles.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 launches at midnight on November 19 in your local time zone, meaning that people in New Zealand will be playing it while I'm still stuck at work on November 18.
body: But that doesn't mean we can't indulge in all the pre-release hype, just like everyone else, and so here we are with a look at the "Vice City hardwood," upon which NBA team the Miami Heat—in the guise of the Vice City's hometown team—will square off against the Milwaukee Bucks.

It's an extensive overhaul, with a huge Vice City logo at center court, the VI logos in the paint, and the "I Heart Vice City" slogans at either end. Yeah, it's marketing, but I have to admit it looks pretty cool too.

Renting an entire NBA team as a promotional tool really puts a finger on just how big Grand Theft Auto 6 is. GTA 5 was big, absolutely, but GTA 6 is huge: Take-Two is looking to make something in the neighborhood of $3.5 billion in GTA 6's launch quarter alone.

And it's not just the dollar signs that impress: GTA 6 is also being recognized as a mainstream cultural phenomenon in ways that previous games in the series never were, or could be. It's honestly kind of amazing how far things have come in the past 40+ years.

videos.title: Hounded - Dev Diary: Meet Duke | PS5 Games
videos.summary: Hounded is officially coming to PS5! Meet the best boy - our protagonist, Duke! Learn all about how to create the main (canine) character in the newest Dev Diary from the IMPRNT team!
body: You are Duke, a determined young Border Collie searching for their lost master through a perilous world. Outwit a relentless Hunter, master the art of scent tracking, and wield the magical power of the Tide to find your master and bring him home.
points: Learn all about how to create the main (canine) character in the newest Dev Diary from the IMPRNT team!

videos.title: Calame - Gameplay Trailer | PS5 Games
videos.summary: Rewrite the battlefield. Shape the rebellion. Change the course of history.
body: Calame is an isometric tactical RPG where strategic combat meets the power to reshape the battlefield. Lead rival factions, master tactical encounters, and fight to overthrow the tyrannical King of Light.
